role.description: Experimental role for paper-grade comparisons. Use candidate, baseline, and ablation across manifest sets.

benchmark_kind.description: Use external/official/public/formal for publication-grade public benchmarks; use procedural/local/fixture/other for smoke or repository examples.

metrics_path.description: Relative path under the adapter workdir where the command writes JSON metrics.

expected_metrics.description: Canonical metrics the benchmark/grader emits and the paper may report.

metric_schema.description: Per-metric definitions keyed by expected metric name.

grader.description: Relative path to grading/evaluation script, if separate from the command.

grader_path.description: Relative path to the frozen local grader/evaluation wrapper file whose SHA256 must match grader_sha256 when provided.

grader_version.description: Version, release tag, package version, or commit of the grader/evaluation protocol.

grader_sha256.description: SHA256 of the grader script, official evaluation wrapper, or frozen grading protocol file.

submission_path.description: Relative path to a generated submission CSV/JSON when the benchmark uses a submission-grade format.

benchmark_url.description: Official benchmark, task suite, or project page URL.

dataset_url.description: Official data/task source URL. May equal benchmark_url for generated or built-in task suites.

dataset_version.description: Stable benchmark/data version, release tag, archive version, or task-suite version used by this adapter.

split_name.description: Named split, task subset, fold, or frozen task manifest used for all compared roles.

split_path.description: Relative path to a frozen local split/task manifest file whose SHA256 must match split_sha256 when provided.

split_sha256.description: SHA256 of the frozen split/task manifest, official split file, or exact task list used by this adapter.

license.description: Benchmark/data/code license string and any publication caveat.

baseline.description: Primary baseline used by this adapter.

baseline_version.description: Baseline implementation version, package version, commit, or release tag.

citation.description: DOI, BibTeX key, or canonical citation for the benchmark/data/baseline.

seed_policy.description: How RESEARCH_AGENT_SEED / repeat_index fixes data split, task sampling, or stochastic solver state.

min_repeats.description: Minimum repeats required before results can support benchmark claims.
